draft.title: Angle sum and exterior angle of a triangle
card: The three angles inside a triangle always add to \(180^{\circ}\). This is true for every triangle, whatever its shape or size.
To find a missing angle, add the two known angles and take the total from \(180^{\circ}\). For angles of \(50^{\circ}\) and \(60^{\circ}\), the third is \(180 - 110 = 70\), so \(70^{\circ}\).
An exterior angle is made by extending one side of the triangle past a corner. It sits outside the triangle, next to the interior angle at that corner.
An exterior angle equals the sum of the two opposite interior angles, the ones not at its corner. If those two are \(50^{\circ}\) and \(60^{\circ}\), the exterior angle is \(110^{\circ}\).
draft.remember: Interior angles add to \(180^{\circ}\). An exterior angle is the sum of the two opposite interior angles.

a.q: A triangle has angles of \(35^{\circ}\) and \(85^{\circ}\). What is the third angle?
a.why: The angles add to \(180^{\circ}\). Add \(35^{\circ}\) and \(85^{\circ}\) to get \(120^{\circ}\), then \(180 - 120 = 60\). The option \(120^{\circ}\) is only the total of the two known angles, so the step of taking it from \(180^{\circ}\) was missed.
a.clue: Add the two known angles, then take the total from 180.

b.q: In triangle PQR, the interior angles at P and Q are \(48^{\circ}\) and \(67^{\circ}\). Side RQ is extended past Q. What is the exterior angle at Q?
b.why: The exterior angle at Q equals the two opposite interior angles, at P and R. The angle at R is \(180 - 48 - 67 = 65\), so the exterior angle is \(48 + 65 = 113\). Adding the angles at P and Q gives \(115^{\circ}\), but Q is not opposite its own exterior angle.
b.clue: Find the angle at R first, then use the two angles not at Q.

wants.brief: A triangle ABC with side BC extended past C. Interior angles at A, B and C are marked. The exterior angle at C, outside the triangle between the extension and side AC, is marked. The angles at A and B are labelled as the two opposite interior angles.
wants.why: It shows which angle is exterior and which two interior angles are opposite it.
